title: Rwarr (Angel Dust)
blurb: Barely a second long, and unmistakably flirtatious. Angel Dust is the most theatrical resident of the Hazbin Hotel, a spider demon with spare arms and no interest whatsoever in reading a room, and this little growl is the noise he makes when something has caught his eye. The fandom clipped it within days. It has become a standard Discord reaction to good character art, good outfits and anything faintly outrageous, largely because it is short enough to spam and camp enough to stay funny on the tenth repeat.
origin: Angel Dust's growl from Hazbin Hotel.
